svg.title: Whole-cell PDL1 intensity and Nimbus calls in the LuCa field
svg.desc: The horizontal line marks the Nimbus score cutoff of 0.5. The vertical line marks the fitted intensity threshold of 3.847. Orange points identify cells whose calls change. Counts in the adjacent table use the same cutoffs.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
g.text: Percentages use the total in each row.
